about: P68 T1 dev set: 40 new English sentences, 8 per new game (stunt, minigolf, railfps, buildshift, drawsave). Written 2026-11-01. Tuning on these is allowed.

sentences.text: a stunt race where a monster truck jumps over ramps and smashes through stacks of crates on the way to the finish line
a dirt bike flies off a wooden ramp in a quarry, crashes through rusty barrels and lands next to the checkered flag
a stunt car race on a rooftop track full of jumps
a grandma on a mobility scooter launches off ramps in a supermarket car park, ploughing through shopping trolleys to reach the exit
a toy race car speeds along a looping track across a bedroom, bursting through block towers and jumping over the bed
drive a jeep through a jungle stunt course, leaping river gaps and smashing wooden fences on the way to the finish
a snowmobile races down a frozen track with big jumps, crashing through snowmen until it crosses the finish

aim and tap to putt the ball across a candy land green, bouncing off lollipops to sink it in one shot
minigolf on the moon with craters and low gravity

draw a ramp so the rolling apple does not fall into the river
